name: vision-kit-monorepo
description: Vision Kit - Sistema de gestión para ópticas (monorepo)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run frontend" "npm run backend" "npm run landing" "npm run admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:landing && npm run build:admin
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:landing && npm run build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting:frontend
scripts.deploy:landing: npm run build:landing && firebase deploy --only hosting:landing
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin
